page.overview:
Who is Rodolfo González?

Rodolfo González is a Venezuelan racing driver competing for in the GP2 championship and test-driving for in the 2013 Formula One Season.

The British Formula 3 National Class Champion in 2006, the Venezuelan joined Marussia in 2013 having driven for (now Caterham) at the 2010 Young Driver Test in Abu Dhabi. He was given a first taste of Formula One action driving Jules Bianchi's car in the first Practice session at the 2013 Bahrain Grand Prix.
